faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 vacancies: 3 Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 1.2.3, 1 Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 2.1, 1 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Program 6.1, Activity 1, 1 Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 6.1, Activity 1, 1 Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 6.1, Activity 3.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure I of this notice (pages 3-4)) and send it to Office of the Cotton Research Station, Degloor Road, Bafna T Point, Nanded 431 604, by by hand (in person), to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 45 years. Relaxation: Age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 30,000 fixed for Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 1.2.3, Rs. 30,000 fixed for Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 2.1, Rs. 37,000 +HRA for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) - Program 6.1, Activity 1, Rs. 30,000 fixed for Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 6.1, Activity 1, Rs. 30,000 fixed for Young Professional - I (YP I) - Program 6.1, Activity 3.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: YP-I: B.Sc (Agri.) / Diploma (Agri.); SRF: M.Sc. (Agri.)/ Ph.D. (Agri.) in Entomology. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who canvass in any form will be disqualified. Candidates found to have submitted false claims will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting based on academic qualification, experience, publication, achievements/awards. Interview. Shortlisting on academic qualification, experience, publication, achievements/awards etc. given in the application form. Shortlisted candidates intimated by Email, WhatsApp or phone call to appear for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary, contractual, co-terminus with the project. Tenure up to 31st March 2027 or till termination of the project whichever is earlier. No claim for regular appointment/absorption in the University or State Government.
